📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Graphs & characteristics图象与特征

A basketball shot, a jet of water, a satellite dish — all parabolas. Six facts (vertex, axis, max/min, domain, range, intercepts) tell you everything about the curve.投篮的轨迹、喷泉的水柱、卫星锅的截面都是抛物线。顶点、对称轴、最值、定义域、值域、截距——掌握这六样，就看懂了整条曲线。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征
  1. a>0 opens up (minimum), a<0 opens down (maximum); the vertex sits on the axis x=−2ab​.a>0 开口向上（有最小值），a<0 开口向下（有最大值）；顶点在对称轴 x=−2ab​ 上。
  2. Range uses the vertex y-value: y≥q (up) or y≤q (down). Domain is always all real numbers.值域看顶点的纵坐标：开口向上 y≥q，向下 y≤q。定义域永远是全体实数。
  3. Axis = midpoint of the zeros, or of any two points at the same height.对称轴 = 两个零点的中点，或任意两个等高点的中点。
x=−2ab​
xaxis​=2r+s​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征

Finding the axis by symmetry用对称性找对称轴

Students only know x=−2ab​ and freeze when no equation is given.很多人只会 x=−2ab​，题目不给方程就卡住。

  1. f(x1​)=f(x2​) ⇒ axis x=2x1​+x2​​f(x1​)=f(x2​) ⇒ 对称轴 x=2x1​+x2​​
  2. Zeros r,s are equal heights too: axis x=2r+s​零点 r,s 也是等高点：对称轴 x=2r+s​
  3. Vertex =(axis, max or min value); then a from one more point顶点 =（对称轴，最值）；再用一个点求 a
Try试一试
A parabola passes through (−3,7) and (5,7) and has minimum value −9. Find the vertex and the range.抛物线过 (−3,7) 和 (5,7)，最小值为 −9。求顶点和值域。
Answer答案
Vertex (1,−9); range y≥−9顶点 (1,−9)；值域 y≥−9

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征
  • Axis of y=2x2+8x as x=2 → x=−2(2)8​=−2 (keep the minus).y=2x2+8x 的对称轴写成 x=2 → 应为 x=−2(2)8​=−2（别丢负号）。
  • Range from the vertex x-value (y≥2 for vertex (2,−5)) → use the y-value: y≥−5.用顶点横坐标写值域（顶点 (2,−5) 写成 y≥2）→ 用纵坐标：y≥−5。
🎯
Find the axis first: one substitution then gives the vertex, the max/min and the range.先求对称轴，再代入一次，顶点、最值、值域全出来。

cards.f: Axis of symmetry of y=ax2+bx+c?y=ax2+bx+c 的对称轴？
cards.b: x=−2ab​ (also the midpoint of the x-intercepts).x=−2ab​（也是两个 x 截距的中点）。

cards.f: How do you tell max or min from the equation?怎样从解析式判断有最大值还是最小值？
cards.b: a>0 opens up → minimum. a<0 opens down → maximum.a>0 开口向上 → 最小值；a<0 开口向下 → 最大值。

cards.f: Domain of any quadratic function?任何二次函数的定义域？
cards.b: All real numbers: {x∣x∈R}.全体实数：{x∣x∈R}。

cards.f: Fastest y-intercept of y=3x2−5x+7?y=3x2−5x+7 的 y 截距怎么最快得到？
cards.b: It is c: (0,7).就是 c：(0,7)。

cards.f: Zeros, roots, x-intercepts — difference?零点、根、x 截距有什么区别？
cards.b: Same numbers: the x-values where f(x)=0. "Root" is for the equation, "zero" for the function, "x-intercept" for the graph.是同一组数：使 f(x)=0 的 x 值。「根」说方程，「零点」说函数，「x 截距」说图象。

quiz.q: For y=x2−6x+5, find the axis of symmetry and the vertex.求 y=x2−6x+5 的对称轴和顶点。
quiz.hint: x=−2ab​=−2−6​
quiz.ans: axis x=3, vertex (3,−4)对称轴 x=3，顶点 (3,−4)
quiz.why: x=3; y=9−18+5=−4.x=3；y=9−18+5=−4。

quiz.q: If f(x)=3x2−x+2, then f(−2) equals:若 f(x)=3x2−x+2，则 f(−2) 等于：
opts: 12
16
8
−8
quiz.hint: Use brackets: 3(−2)2−(−2)+2.加括号：3(−2)2−(−2)+2。
quiz.ans: 16
quiz.why: 3(4)+2+2=16.3(4)+2+2=16。

quiz.q: For y=−2x2+8x−3, state the vertex, max or min value, and range.对 y=−2x2+8x−3，写出顶点、最值和值域。
quiz.hint: x=−2(−2)8​
quiz.ans: vertex (2,5), maximum 5, range y≤5顶点 (2,5)，最大值 5，值域 y≤5
quiz.why: x=2, y=−8+16−3=5. a<0, so it is a maximum and y≤5.x=2，y=−8+16−3=5。a<0，是最大值，值域 y≤5。

quiz.q: Find the x-intercepts and y-intercept of y=x2+2x−8.求 y=x2+2x−8 的 x 截距和 y 截距。
quiz.hint: Factor: two numbers that multiply to −8 and add to 2.分解：乘积 −8、和为 2 的两个数。
quiz.ans: x-intercepts −4 and 2; y-intercept −8x 截距 −4 和 2；y 截距 −8
quiz.why: (x+4)(x−2)=0 gives x=−4, 2. y-intercept is c=−8.(x+4)(x−2)=0，得 x=−4, 2。y 截距是 c=−8。

quiz.q: A parabola has x-intercepts −7 and 3 and a minimum value of −50. What is its vertex?一条抛物线的 x 截距是 −7 和 3，最小值为 −50。顶点是什么？
opts: (−2,−50)
(2,−50)
(−5,−50)
(−50,−2)
quiz.hint: The axis is the midpoint of the intercepts.对称轴是两截距的中点。
quiz.ans: (−2,−50)
quiz.why: x=2−7+3​=−2; the min value is the y-coordinate.x=2−7+3​=−2；最小值就是纵坐标。

quiz.q: The points (−1,6) and (5,6) are on a parabola whose vertex has y-value −3. Find the vertex and the range if the parabola opens up.点 (−1,6) 和 (5,6) 在一条抛物线上，顶点纵坐标为 −3，开口向上。求顶点和值域。
quiz.hint: Two points with the same y-value are mirror images across the axis.纵坐标相同的两点关于对称轴对称。
quiz.ans: vertex (2,−3), range y≥−3顶点 (2,−3)，值域 y≥−3
quiz.why: Axis x=2−1+5​=2, so the vertex is (2,−3); opening up gives y≥−3.对称轴 x=2−1+5​=2，顶点 (2,−3)；开口向上，值域 y≥−3。

quiz.q: For f(x)=x2−4x−12, find all x with f(x)=−12, and the minimum value of f.对 f(x)=x2−4x−12，求所有使 f(x)=−12 的 x，以及 f 的最小值。
quiz.hint: Set x2−4x−12=−12; the axis is halfway between the two answers.令 x2−4x−12=−12；对称轴在两个解正中间。
quiz.ans: x=0 or x=4; minimum −16x=0 或 x=4；最小值 −16
quiz.why: x2−4x=0⇒x(x−4)=0, so x=0 or 4.x2−4x=0⇒x(x−4)=0，得 x=0 或 4。

quiz.q: A decorative fountain in a Vancouver plaza shoots a jet of water from a nozzle at ground level, and the jet lands 6 m away. At 1 m from the nozzle the water is 2.5 m high. Let x be the horizontal distance from the nozzle. (a) Find the equation of the path and the maximum height. (b) Between which two horizontal distances is the water at least 4 m high? Use symmetry to explain why the answers are where they are.温哥华广场上的装饰喷泉从地面的喷嘴射出一股水柱，落点距喷嘴 6 m。距喷嘴 1 m 处水柱高 2.5 m。设 x 为到喷嘴的水平距离。(a) 求水柱路径的方程和最大高度。(b) 水柱在哪两个水平距离之间高度至少 4 m？用对称性解释为什么答案落在那两处。
quiz.hint: Ground level at x=0 and x=6 gives the factored form y=ax(x−6); use the point (1,2.5) for a.地面高度出现在 x=0 和 x=6，所以设 y=ax(x−6)，再用点 (1,2.5) 求 a。
quiz.ans: y=−21​x(x−6); maximum 4.5 m at x=3; at least 4 m high for 2≤x≤4y=−21​x(x−6)；最大高度 4.5 m（在 x=3 处）；2≤x≤4 时高度至少 4 m
quiz.why: The jet is at height 0 when x=0 and x=6, so y=ax(x−6). From (1,2.5): 2.5=a(1)(−5), so a=−21​ and y=−21​x(x−6).水柱高度为 0 的位置是 x=0 和 x=6，所以 y=ax(x−6)。代入 (1,2.5)：2.5=a(1)(−5)，得 a=−21​，y=−21​x(x−6)。
